basic_magicks.name: Basic Magicks
basic_magicks.description: Caelan can already produce small, controlled magical effects. Sustained force against a strong current remains beyond his present strength.

brace.name: Brace
brace.description: A defensive technique for steadying yourself against an incoming attack.

mend.name: Mend
mend.description: A restorative spell whose healing power is governed by Spirit.

focused_strike.name: Focused Strike
focused_strike.description: A deliberate physical technique focused on one opponent.

sweeping_strike.name: Sweeping Strike
sweeping_strike.description: A broad physical technique intended to reach nearby opponents.

guarded_strike.name: Guarded Strike
guarded_strike.description: A measured physical attack made from a guarded stance.

piercing_strike.name: Piercing Strike
piercing_strike.description: A precise physical technique for finding an opening in a sturdy defense.

rally.name: Rally
rally.description: A supportive technique for helping an ally regain their composure.

intercept.name: Intercept
intercept.description: A protective technique for stepping into the path of an attack aimed at an ally.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.description: A physical response made after meeting an attack with a guard.

aether_dart.name: Aether Dart
aether_dart.description: A small, focused damaging spell whose power is governed by Magick.

aether_arc.name: Aether Arc
aether_arc.description: An arcing damaging spell intended to reach several opponents; power is governed by Magick.

aether_lance.name: Aether Lance
aether_lance.description: A concentrated damaging spell directed at one opponent; power is governed by Magick.

aether_burst.name: Aether Burst
aether_burst.description: A broader release of damaging magicks whose power is governed by Magick.

greater_mend.name: Greater Mend
greater_mend.description: A stronger restorative spell whose healing power is governed by Spirit.

renew.name: Renew
renew.description: A sustained restorative working whose healing power is governed by Spirit.

cleanse.name: Cleanse
cleanse.description: A restorative working intended to remove a harmful affliction.

ward.name: Ward
ward.description: A protective working intended to soften incoming magicks.

dispel.name: Dispel
dispel.description: A controlled working for unraveling an existing magical effect.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: A concentration technique for managing the effort of sustained casting.

steadfast.name: Steadfast
steadfast.description: A defensive technique for maintaining a steady position under pressure.
